space.oldrepublic.comm.pirate.hail.0: Cut your engines and open your hold. Nobody has to get hurt. Much.
space.oldrepublic.comm.pirate.hail.1: Pretty ship. It'll look better with our marks on it.
space.oldrepublic.comm.pirate.hail.2: You're flying the kajidic's lanes without paying the toll. The toll just went up.
space.oldrepublic.comm.hymn.hail.0: The Hymn hears your engines, little ship. Be silent.
space.oldrepublic.comm.hymn.hail.1: This sky belongs to the song. Turn back or be unmade.
space.oldrepublic.comm.hymn.hail.2: A voice out of tune. We will correct it.
space.oldrepublic.comm.clan.hail.0: Clan Hask remembers your name. Fight, and be remembered better.
space.oldrepublic.comm.clan.hail.1: You owe the clan blood. We came to collect it.
space.oldrepublic.comm.blockade.hail: Tyrvann's sky is closed by order of Darth Ulvaine. Heave to, or we take you apart and bring her what is left.
space.oldrepublic.comm.blockade.varra: The clan's contract ends today. Hask wings, break formation and fly with the singer!
space.oldrepublic.comm.blockade.wave: Second wing, launch. Cripple the ship and keep the singer breathing. She was very clear.
space.oldrepublic.comm.blockade.generato: The shield generator is gone! Every gun on that ship, now!
space.oldrepublic.comm.blockade.broken: The gunship is breaking up. All wings, fall back to the Hymnal!
space.oldrepublic.comm.blockade.varra_br: That is how a blockade dies. Tyrvann's sky is open, singer. The holdfast will see you land.
space.oldrepublic.comm.pass.hail: Hold your fire, all wings. That is the singer. The Darth wants this one untouched.
space.oldrepublic.comm.pass.through: Open the lane. Let the singer go down to Tyrvann. The Hymn will be waiting.
space.oldrepublic.comm.scan.clan: Clan Hask patrol. Hold your course and let us read your hold.
space.oldrepublic.comm.scan.pirate: Hold still, courier. Let's see what you're hauling.
space.oldrepublic.comm.scan.done: Scan complete. We know what you're carrying now, and so will everyone else.
space.oldrepublic.comm.scan.provoked: They fired on us! All fighters, weapons free!
space.oldrepublic.comm.ace.hail.0: Another bounty chit with a ship around it. Wings, give them room to run.
space.oldrepublic.comm.ace.hail.1: Every hunter who came for me is drifting in a ring around this world. Come and join them.
space.oldrepublic.comm.ace.hail.2: So the board finally priced me high enough. I'm flattered. Now die.
space.oldrepublic.comm.ace.down: Lead is down! Break off, break off!
space.oldrepublic.spindle.vault_empty: The vault stands empty. The station restocks it once a day.
space.oldrepublic.spindle.vault_opened: The vault's seals give with a hiss of stale air.
